title: 第3章 不是这对吗第4章 跟传闻中的完全不一样嘛
content_zh:
;;
一则足以点燃整个皇家魔法学院的消息，如同坠入滚油的火星，在短短一个上午炸裂开来，引发了滔天巨浪。
尊贵的帝国明珠，皇帝陛下最宠爱的幼女希琳公主，竟在学院中庭，众目睽睽之下，向她的未婚夫——北境大公之子克洛伊·奥罗斯特·多铎，发起了神圣的“誓约决斗”
赌注是那桩维系着帝国与北境安定的婚约！
消息像长了翅膀，以极快的速度飞遍了学院的每一个角落，自然也传到了学校的医务室。
阳光透过洁净的玻璃窗，在光洁的地板上投下斑驳的光影。
索罗斯，这位在不久前的实战课上因“意外”
而双腿骨折的少年，正安静地躺在病床上。
他有着一头略显凌乱的棕色短发，面容虽因失血而有些苍白，但那双眼眸依旧明亮。
希琳公主坐在床边的椅子上，褪去了在人前的骄傲与刚烈，此刻的她显得异常沉静柔和。
她正用那双纤细白皙手掌为病床上的少年仔细地削着苹果。
她对待索罗斯的态度，与面对克洛伊时判若两人。
在她心中，索罗斯是特殊的。
他是学院里少有的不因她尊贵的公主身份而阿谀奉承她，也不因皇室威严而疏远畏惧她的人。
他看到的只是“希琳”
本身。
正是这份难得的纯粹，才让她无比珍惜这段友谊，也正因如此，当得知索罗斯在实战课上被克洛伊伺机以阴狠手段打断腿时，她积压已久的怒火才遏制不住地冲破了临界点。
克洛伊的暴行，不仅伤害了她重视的朋友，更是对她尊严和底线的践踏。
“希琳……”
索罗斯率先忍不住打破了医务室里的静谧氛围：“大家都在传，你向克洛伊发起了誓约决斗，要解除婚约？”

公主手上削苹果的动作几不可查地顿了顿，长长的睫毛垂下，遮掩了眸中一闪而过的复杂情绪。
她轻轻“嗯”
了一声，算是承认。
索罗斯脸上立刻浮现出浓浓的忧虑：“可是……这样真的没关系吗？我听说，你与克洛伊的婚约事关北境安定，皇帝陛下他……会允许吗？”
希琳抿了抿粉嫩的薄唇，将削好的苹果递给他，随后，才语气平静道：“学院决斗场的规矩，是先祖立国时就与元老院共同立下的铁律，象征着公平与誓言不可轻侮。”
“既然克洛伊亲口答应了决斗，那么即便是父皇，也不能违背。”
索罗斯愣了愣，他垂下眼帘，接过苹果，却没有吃，脸上写满了内疚，“如果不是我太没用，也不会让你为了我，去冒触怒陛下的风险……”
“不，索罗斯，别这么说。”
希琳摇了摇头，眼神坚定地看着他：“即便没有你这件事，只要有机会，我也一定会想办法解除这桩婚约。”
“我无法想象，未来的岁月要与一个只懂得倚仗家世欺软怕硬的懦夫共度，那会让我感到无比恶心，在这件事上，我反而要感谢你，是你的受伤，让我下定了最后的决心。”
她顿了顿，声音柔和下来：“而且，你是我认可的朋友，你受了不公的欺辱，如果我不为你出头，还有谁能呢？”
索罗斯怔怔地看着眼前神情坚定的少女，胸腔中被一种难以言喻的感动所填满。
......
与外界汹涌的舆情不同，作为这场风暴的另一个中心，克洛伊本人却显得异常平静，甚至可以说是……置身事外。
他此刻正窝在皇家魔法学院那宏伟如宫殿般的图书馆深处，一个靠窗的僻静角落里。
窗外的喧嚣仿佛与他隔着一个世界。
三天后的决斗？他压根没放在心上。
输掉比赛，解除婚约，和主角团说拜拜，这套流程在他穿越过来理清现状的那一刻就已经定好了。
公主是主角的，婚约对于他这个小反派而言，不是什么恩典，反而是一颗随时会点爆危及他小命的定时炸弹。
他现在更关心的，是这个世界到底靠不靠谱，别是什么魔改版本，那他的“先知”

优势可就大打折扣了。
content_en:
;;
A piece of news that could ignite the entire Royal Academy of Magic was like a spark falling into boiling oil, exploding in just one morning, causing huge waves.
The noble pearl of the empire, His Majesty the Emperor's favorite young daughter, Princess Shireen, unexpectedly launched a sacred "Duel of Oaths" to her fiancé, Chloe Orost Dodo, the son of the Grand Duke of the North, in the courtyard of the academy, in full view of everyone.
The bet is the marriage contract that maintains the stability of the empire and the north!
The news seemed to have wings, flying to every corner of the college at an extremely fast speed, and naturally also reached the school's infirmary.
The sun shines through the clean glass windows, casting mottled light and shadow on the smooth floor.
Soros, the man who died in an "accident" in a practical class not long ago
The boy with broken legs was lying quietly on the hospital bed.
He had slightly messy short brown hair, and although his face was a little pale due to blood loss, his eyes were still bright.
Princess Shireen sat on the chair beside the bed. Her pride and fierceness in front of others had faded away. At this moment, she looked extremely calm and gentle.
She was using her slender white hands to carefully peel the apple for the boy on the hospital bed.
Her attitude towards Soros was completely different from her attitude towards Chloe.
In her mind, Soros was special.
He is one of the few people in the academy who does not flatter her because of her noble status as a princess, nor does he alienate and fear her because of the majesty of the royal family.
All he saw was "Shireen"
itself.
It was this rare purity that made her cherish this friendship so much. It was also because of this that when she learned that Soros had been broken by Chloe in a practical class in a vicious way, her long-standing anger could not be contained and broke through the critical point.
Chloe's violence not only hurt the friends she valued, but also trampled on her dignity and bottom line.
"Shireen..."
Soros took the lead and couldn't help but break the quiet atmosphere in the infirmary: "Everyone is spreading the news that you challenged Chloe to a duel and want to break off the engagement?"
The princess paused almost unnoticeably while peeling the apple, and her long eyelashes drooped, covering up the complex emotions that flashed in her eyes.
She said softly "Hmm"
A cry was considered an admission.
Thoros' face immediately showed deep worry: "But...does it really matter? I heard that your engagement with Chloe is related to the stability of the North. Will His Majesty the Emperor...allow it?"
Shirin pursed her thin pink lips, handed him the peeled apple, and then said in a calm tone: "The rules of the academy's duel field are iron laws established by the ancestors and the Senate when the country was founded. It symbolizes fairness and oaths that cannot be taken lightly."
"Since Chloe personally agreed to the duel, even my father cannot break it."
Thoros was stunned. He lowered his eyes and took the apple, but did not eat it. His face was full of guilt. "If I weren't so useless, I wouldn't let you take the risk of offending His Majesty for me..."
"No, Soros, don't say that."
Shireen shook her head and looked at him firmly: "Even if it wasn't for you, as long as I have the chance, I will definitely find a way to terminate this engagement."
"I can't imagine spending the next few years with a coward who only knows how to rely on his family background to bully the weak and fear the strong. That would make me feel extremely sick. In this matter, I would like to thank you. It was your injury that made me make my final decision."
She paused and her voice softened: "Besides, you are a friend I recognize. You have been unfairly bullied. If I don't stand up for you, who else can?"
Thoros stared blankly at the determined girl in front of him, his chest filled with an indescribable feeling.
...
Different from the turbulent public opinion outside, as another center of this storm, Chloe herself seemed extremely calm, and could even be said to be... aloof.
He is at this momentHe was nestled deep in the palace-like library of the Royal Academy of Magic, in a secluded corner by the window.
The noise outside the window seemed to be a world away from him.
The duel in three days? He didn't take it to heart at all.
Losing the game, breaking off the engagement, and saying goodbye to the protagonist group, this process was already set the moment he traveled through time to sort out the current situation.
The princess belongs to the protagonist, and the engagement is not a favor to him, a little villain, but a time bomb that can explode at any time and endanger his life.
What he is more concerned about now is whether this world is reliable, let alone some magically modified version, then his "prophet"
The advantages are greatly reduced.
